svg.title: A05 VOYAGER CILIA ARRAY engineering architecture
svg.desc: Mechanics and readout are separately calibrated before inversion. The diagram exposes temperature and wall drag as nuisance pathways and requires rank/validity gates before reporting two fluid parameters.
